cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. At the house meeting, back me up about the bins being Alex's turn. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Only on the old rota. Remember the new conversation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're having it now. Try to remember it confidently.

mechanism: A chairs a household rota discussion but reshapes the proposed bin assignment around B conditions so B will support it.
confusable: Unlike simple delegation, A needs B backing at a later meeting; unlike secure authority A lets B revise the proposal while claiming leadership.
comparison: Household fairness and shared proposal wording differ from a colleague refusing false testimony about a work shift.
seedUse: Use D31-a bin rota and sought support, plus S02-a claiming a modified decision; replace fabricated memory with negotiated backing.
